items.title: Why Is RTX (RTX) Stock Soaring Today
items.summary: Shares of aerospace and defense company Raytheon (NYSE:RTX) jumped 7.2% in the afternoon session after the company reported strong second-quarter earnings that beat expectations and raised its full-year guidance. The aerospace and defense giant delivered $1.89 in adjusted earnings per share on $24.71 billion in revenue, a 14.5% increase from the previous year.
